title: ML↔SEC-001: Model Integrity Requirements + Security Review
description: Security provides model-integrity, anti-extraction, and anti-tampering requirements for edge-deployed models; Edge AI/ML provides model artifacts and metadata for threat assessment and awareness of the deployment target. Grounded in SECURITY_ENGINEER_SKILL §6.7 (Edge AI/ML Engineer).

deployment_target.description: Target the integrity protections apply to, e.g. 'STM32H7 edge node'.

integrity_requirements.description: SEC→ML: required protections for the deployed model.

model_signing_required.description: Model bundle must be signed and verified on-device.

model_anti_rollback.description: Per-model monotonic version counter (mitigates FMEA FC-026 residual risk).

exposes_outputs_externally.description: Whether inference outputs cross a trust boundary (informs information-disclosure risk).

x-macp.tier_rationale: Model-integrity is a security surface — ESC-SEC; SEC owns binding verdicts. A change weakening model signing/anti-rollback is a security-baseline change → Tier-1.
x-macp.cadence: TRIGGER (requirements alignment at planning; model-integrity review when model formats or deployment targets change)
confirm_conditions: model_signing_required = true and model_metadata provides a matching signature_algorithm
model_anti_rollback = true where the deployment target supports a per-model monotonic counter
anti_extraction / anti_tampering levels satisfied for the target
reject_conditions: model_anti_rollback = false on a production target (FC-026 residual risk — ESC-SEC)
counter_conditions: anti_extraction = REQUIRED but target hardware cannot enforce it — escalate to ARCH+SEC trade-off
APPROVED_WITH_CONDITIONS — log conditions to the §3.3 checklist before proceeding
